gaps.explanation: Re-read pp7-8 (governmental funds statement), pp15-19 (Budget and Actual (Budget Basis) schedules of General, Keno, Streets, LB 840, Downtown Development) and pp20-21 (nonmajor combining statement). Every fund is in detail[] exactly once (majors from their budget schedules, the nine nonmajor funds from the combining statement); no fund column without lines, no subtotal/total row, no budget column read as actual, no fund from two sources. Total revenues statement vs schedule actual: General 3,730,043 vs 5,853,100 (+2,123,057); Keno 1,878,572 vs 1,906,958 (+28,386); Street 2,004,330 vs 2,460,565 (+456,235); LB 840 398,991 vs 603,712 (+204,721); Downtown Development 509,884 vs 507,303 (-2,581); Nonmajor 2,237,401 (p8 column) vs 2,237,404 (p21 combining Total Nonmajor, the report's own 3 difference: Other revenue 60,617 on p8 vs 60,620 on p21). Sum 2,809,824 vs gap 2,809,820 (rounding). Cause: the budget-basis schedules have no other-financing section; their 'Local' lines carry what the GAAP statement prints under OTHER FINANCE SOURCES (General Operating transfers in 1,949,200 + Payments received from loan 14,211; Street transfers in 477,024; LB 840 transfers in 108,799 + loan payments 102,057), net of other budget-basis differences. The budget roll-forwards are complete without transfer rows (p15 General 704,352 + 2,763,662 = 3,468,014; GAAP ending 3,284,892), so the transfers are inside the printed lines. No budget-to-GAAP reconciliation is printed. Statement side checked: JSON receipts = p8 Total column, 10,759,221 printed. No fix.

Total expenditures statement vs schedule: General 4,872,002 vs 5,148,748 (+276,746); Keno 2,314,245 vs 2,314,245 (detail holds the p16 'Community development' 2,314,245 split per the p7 Keno column 1,712,731 + 601,514); Street 2,003,142 vs 2,000,718 (-2,424); LB 840 444,070 vs 444,072 (+2); Downtown Development 56,368 vs 345,166 (+288,798 = its Operating transfers out 288,799, rounding 1); Nonmajor 2,643,838 vs 2,643,838 (0). Sum 563,122 vs gap 563,121 (rounding). The budget-basis expenditures include the transfers out the GAAP statement prints under other financing (Downtown exactly; General transfers out 300,222 vs +276,746, the rest other budget-basis differences). Printed budget lines are kept; nothing duplicated; no line missing. No fix.

Statement p7-8 Operating transfers in: General 1,949,200 + Street 477,024 + LB 840 108,799 + Nonmajor 105,150 = Total 2,640,173 (no Eliminations column this year). Detail 105,150 = Economic Development Fund 60,000 + Capital Sinking Fund 45,150 (p20 combining; ties). General, Street and LB 840 transfers in have no rows on their budget-basis schedules (pp15, 17, 18); the money is inside the schedules' 'Local' revenue lines (see revenue entry), so adding the p7-8 cells would count it twice. Gap 1,949,200 + 477,024 + 108,799 = 2,535,023. No fix.

Statement p7-8 Operating transfers out: General (300,222) + Downtown Development (288,799) + Nonmajor (526,224) = Total (1,115,245). Detail (526,224) = Debt Service Fund (49,200) + Capital Projects Fund (477,024) (pp20-21 combining; ties). The General and Downtown transfers out are inside their budget-basis expenditure lines (p19 Downtown Economic Development 345,166 = GAAP 56,368 + 288,799 - 1; p15 General 5,148,748 vs GAAP 4,872,002), so adding them would count the money twice. Gap 300,222 + 288,799 = 589,021. No fix.
